NOTES carried forward, still relevant for any future work in this repo: (1) sequence .mmd sources are NOT persisted; (2) sequence renders live in their OWNING ISSUE's folder; (3) renders.lock can go stale silently after an as-built XML edit - re-run `python audit.py --record-renders` at close; (4) map.yaml's ucs: lists must be real workbook UC codes only, never an issue id; (5) IndexedStack-based navigation means every FloatingActionButton needs an explicit unique heroTag - six across the app as of FEAT04, check for collisions before adding more; (6) a clean local audit.py pass does NOT prove CI will pass - only the actual CI log surfaces a glob()-ordering-dependent bug (fixed 2026-08-23); (7) BEFORE writing a new screen/class, check the relevant class diagram has a box for it - flutter-coder halting on FEAT04's AccountsScreen is the model to follow; a genuinely private per-file widget (like FEAT05's _CategoryAutocompleteField) does NOT need a diagram entry - check whether the new thing is a tracked class (Screen/Provider/DAO/Notifier) or private implementation detail before halting; (8) this project is a pilot run for a different target project (owner's own words, 2026-08-24) - the process trail itself is part of what gets extracted later, so keep the same discipline on these post-backlog polish items as on the original tracked issues; (9) a plain ListView(children: [...]) in a widget test does NOT build off-screen children automatically (Sliver-realized, not eager) - a widget test asserting on content below the fold must scroll first (tester.drag + pumpAndSettle), caught in FEAT07's chart tests when the third chart card silently never built; (10) a subagent can hit its own session/usage limit mid-task and terminate without finishing - check `git status`/diff for partial, uncommitted work before assuming a 'failed' task notification means nothing was done; FEAT07's coder got the DAO layer fully done and correct before terminating, and that work was kept and built on rather than redone.
